name: Malvern Vision Care
description: Optometry in Malvern, Chester County. Eye exams and optical care for people who want the prescription filled by the same office that measured it.

hero.headline: Vision care in Malvern
hero.sub: Malvern Vision Care serves Chester County. The current homepage is not built for a phone. The exam still is.

offerings.heading: Measure, fit, follow up.
items: Eye exams for the people who already work and live in Malvern.
Optical dispensing so the pair leaves the same building.
A follow-up when the first pair is not quite right.

story.heading: Chester County eyecare
paragraphs: Malvern Vision Care is an optometry practice in Malvern. The radar scored the site as broken: no viewport, a desktop-width page on phones.
Confirm the street address, phone, and hours on the official site before you drive. Facts we cannot verify stay off this page.

experience.heading: One office, one prescription.
items: The exam and the frames live in the same conversation.
You leave with a pair you saw on your own face.
You can come back when the fit needs a tweak.

feature.heading: The phone page should not fight the exam
feature.text: A practice that measures your eyes should not make you pinch-zoom the homepage. That is the rebuild.

spotlight.heading: Malvern and the Main Line edge
spotlight.text: If Malvern is the workday, this is the eyecare stop that does not send you into King of Prussia traffic for a fitting.

contact.heading: Confirm before you drive.
contact.sub: Malvern, Chester County. Pull live address and hours from the official site.
